notes.subject: לב ... לבם
notes.rationale: 'heart' repeats — 'heart walks after the heart of their idols' — the doubling is the verse's rhetoric.

notes.subject: heart walketh after the heart of
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS keep the literal double 'heart'; BSB collapses to 'hearts pursue' — the shape is lost.

notes.subject: דרכם בראשם
notes.rationale: 'their way on their head' = bring back their conduct upon them, recompense; literal kept with 'putim roda long het'.

translation: Long ol we bel bilong ol i wokabaut olsem bel bilong ol olsem piksa nogut bilong ol, na ol samting nogut tru bilong ol, mi putim ol roda bilong ol long het bilong ol — Adonai Yahwe i tok.

tokens.gloss: na ol samting nogut tru bilong ol
